title: なおころ。(人生すごろく)
entry: prototypes/life-sugoroku/index.html (title 'なおころ。｜人生すごろく'); linked from main game index.html:500 (naokoroDialog index.html:496, script.js:20412). Loads ../../audio.js then main-v4.mjs.
allowlist: Not in allowlist 'entrypoints' but its HTML (index.html, legacy.html, v4.html) and 48 runtime files are in allowlist 'files' (tools/pages/allowlist.json).

audio.bgm: OFF (forced). main-v4.mjs:16 audioSettings = {lifetime:{soundSfx:true, soundBgm:false, quickVoice:'tts'}}; installNaotocchiAudio is called with isGameActive:()=>true, getActiveMinigame:()=>null (main-v4.mjs:17). Because bgmOn() is false the scheduler never starts a track. Inference: if soundBgm were flipped on, currentScene() would always return 'game' (isGameActive true, genre fallback 'action').
audio.sfx: Only from embedded official minigames: official-runtime S.sfx(name) -> onSound -> officialAudio.play(name) (official-runtime-v4.mjs:38; main-v4.mjs:126). Played only for human seats or when CPU speed is 'normal'. Board/dice/event phases do not call audio.
audio.voice: Quick-minigame instruction voice (e.g. 'たべろ！') via officialAudio.voice -> TTS default (main-v4.mjs:127; audio.js voice()).
audio.legacy: legacy.html + main.mjs (V2/V3 saves) do not load audio.js: no sound at all.
